Database._doc: Provider (Postgres | MySql, default Postgres) picks the business store and its connection string (ConnectionStrings:ECommercePostgres or ECommerceMySql; empty here, set by appsettings.Development.json for the local docker stack and by the environment elsewhere), whose Maximum Pool Size sizes the unit-of-work pool, the outbox-dispatcher pool and the cache pool. MaxConnections is the server's connection budget: the three business pools plus Saga:MaxPoolSize, when the saga shares the engine, must fit it or the host refuses to start.

Saga._doc: Provider (Postgres | MySql, default Postgres) picks the saga store independently of Database:Provider; it reuses that engine's connection string with its own pool of MaxPoolSize connections. ResumerEnabled and JanitorEnabled toggle the hosted saga workers (default true).

Bus._doc: DispatcherEnabled toggles the hosted outbox dispatcher (default true); PollInterval paces it while the outbox is idle (default 00:00:05).

Cache._doc: The two-tier cache keeps its durable entries in the business store (Database:Provider). L1Ttl bounds how long each instance trusts its in-memory copy (default 00:01:00); SweepEnabled toggles the hosted sweep of expired entries (default true) and SweepInterval paces it (default 00:05:00).

Token._doc: SigningKey is a secret and ships empty: supply it through user-secrets locally (keys listed in secrets.template.json) and through the environment in containers.

Customers._doc: BootstrapAdminExternalIds lists the external ids provisioned as administrators on their first session; an administrator grants the permissions of every other member through PUT /api/v1/members/{customerId}/grants.

Catalog._doc: UnitPrice is the price of one unit of any product, and DiscountRate the fraction of the line total every order is discounted (0.1 is 10%); GET /api/v1/orders/{orderId} prices the order with them. A UnitPrice that is not positive leaves the order readable, its summary and description carrying PRICE_MUST_BE_POSITIVE instead of a total.
